event.description: Tie the closest pair of positional embedding scalars
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,118 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 4 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0029, which shared complete attention and feed-forward transforms and reached 99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0034, bias-only LayerNorm sharing that peaked at 93.95% internal validation. The most recent overall attempt, 0061 in scalar pruning, scored 54.19% and closed further scale neutralization. In the retained 512-scalar positional table, flattened coordinates 77 and 498 are the closest pair, 0.00077429198 and 0.00077445369, differing by only 1.617e-7. Hypothesis: representing them with one shared trainable mean preserves qualification and yields 2,117 parameters. This is more informative than the next-closest positional pair because it is the minimal possible honest tying perturbation; the integer reconstruction map contains no learned values.
